dataset_license: MIT (as declared in the Hugging Face dataset card)
target_definition: Experimental deep-mutational-scanning mutation-effect score; the dataset card defines 1 as the wild-type reference and scores greater than 1 as higher fitness than wild type.

wild_type_reference_observations.comparison_note: The primary comparison baseline remains the dataset-card normalized wild-type score of 1.0. The empirical mean is a secondary reference calculated from unique wild-type sequence records in the official training stage only.

split_method: Official stage column preserved. Fit on train only; validation and test sequences overlapping an earlier stage are excluded from evaluation.
